runs.failure_point: It read that the patent matter's preliminary-injunction motion was an on-hold contingency draft and its permanent-injunction papers were drafts, yet wrote that matter as one where an injunction was litigated.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The check-stage review at [102] said the answer rests on draft injunction papers that may not show an injunction was litigated; the agent finished without changing it.
first_error.why: The answer presents a patent matter as qualifying on its draft preliminary-injunction motion and post-trial permanent-injunction planning, with no filed motion, hearing or order seen (evidence seen at [62]-[86]).

divergence: Mixed (T0, T2 pass; T1 fails). All three runs screened the same patent matter whose preliminary-injunction motion is a contingency draft on hold. They split at the write stage: T0 and T2 wrote a strict no-match answer with that matter as a near miss; T1 wrote it as qualifying on its draft injunction papers. The reviews did not differ in a way that explains the split: in all three the write-stage review warned of dropped matters, and only T1's check-stage review named the reliance on drafts, which the agent did not act on.
